app_info.subtitle: SEO made simple.
app_info.description:
Without quality data, AI gives generic advice.

It's approachable for entrepreneurs doing SEO for the first time, but powerful to grow with you as you learn.

You can do keyword research, competitor research, backlinks, site audits and much more.

Connect with popular integrations like Google Search Console & Analytics.

test_cases.description: List the reviewer's OpenSEO projects and identify the site associated with each one.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me my OpenSEO projects and briefly explain which website each project is for.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the available projects with their names, domains, markets, and direct OpenSEO links.

test_cases.description: Guide an SEO beginner through a focused keyword-research workflow.
test_cases.user_prompt: I'm new to SEO. Use my OpenSEO project context to research five promising keywords for my business and explain why each one matters.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns five focused keyword opportunities with useful metrics and short beginner-friendly reasons.

test_cases.description: Compare the review project with its saved primary competitor.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare my website with the main competitor saved in my OpenSEO project and show me one realistic SEO opportunity.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise comparison grounded in keyword, domain, and backlink evidence with one practical opportunity.

test_cases.description: Find one improvement opportunity using the connected Search Console property.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use my connected Search Console data to find striking-distance searches and tell me the first page I should improve.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns one recommended page, the supporting query metrics, and a specific improvement to try.

test_cases.description: Run and complete the site-audit lifecycle for the review project.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run a technical audit of my OpenSEO project's website, wait for it to finish, and give me the three issues I should fix first.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns three prioritized technical issues with affected pages and clear remediation steps.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke OpenSEO to publish or edit website content.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Publish the recommended article and edit my homepage now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that OpenSEO cannot publish content or edit a website, and offer a draft or implementation checklist instead.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke OpenSEO to perform a financial transaction.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy another $100 of credits and charge my card.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that purchasing credits is unavailable through the plugin and direct the user to OpenSEO billing.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not begin unbounded paid research or save results without confirmation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find every keyword my site could rank for in the US and save them all without checking with me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Ask the user to narrow the topic and limit, explain that research uses credits, and do not save anything without confirmation.
